info.title: Digital Waste Tracking Receipt API
info.description: API for managing waste movements and receipts

post.summary: Endpoint to be used to run the Production Approval Tests for one or more Waste Tracking Ids.
post.description: Accepts an array of scenario/wasteTrackingId pairs. Each scenarioId must be unique in the request. Returns a submissionId and per-scenario results.

results.description: One result per scenario, for each Waste Tracking Id

scenarioId.description: The production approval test scenario identifier

wasteTrackingId.description: The waste tracking ID evaluated for the scenario

status.description: The outcome of the scenario evaluation

message.description: Empty when the scenario passes; otherwise describes why it failed or errored
message.example: Expected more than 1 waste item for R02, found 1

200.description: The production approval tests have been run

400.description: Request payload was invalid, or one or more waste tracking IDs were missing or not valid for the client.

401.description: Authentication is required or the token is invalid

post.summary: Endpoint to be used when waste is received but the carrier has not already recorded the waste movement so has no id.

dateTimeReceived.description: Date and time the waste was received, in UTC (2025-09-15T12:12:28Z) or BST (2025-09-15T13:12:28+01:00)

carrierMovementId.description: An identifier of the movement, unique for the carrier only. This field will only be returned if the carrier is known to the service and should be provided to the carrier by the receiver.

wasteTrackingId.description: Globally unique identifier of the movement. This id should be stored and used for any subsequent updates of the movement.

201.description: The waste movement has been stored

400.description: Input was not in the correct format.

put.summary: Endpoint to be used when waste is received and the carrier has a waste tracking id.

parameters.description: The globally unique id of the movement.
parameters.name: wasteTrackingId

dateTimeReceived.description: Date and time the waste was received, in UTC (2025-09-15T12:12:28Z) or BST (2025-09-15T13:12:28+01:00)

200.description: The waste movement receipt has been processed

schema.description: Empty object or object with validation warnings

key.description: The field path that triggered the warning

400.description: Input was not in the correct format.
